overviewHtml:
Business processes like claims handling are hard to see from infrastructure metrics alone. This dashboard shows how to visualize one process end to end in Dynatrace.

What you get

  • Performance and status of an insurance claims process
  • Dashboard JSON ready to import
  • Sample log data to try it out
setupHtml:
Follow these steps to import and use the dashboard in your Dynatrace environment:

  1. Download the Dashboard - insurance claims processing.json file from this repository.
  2. In Dynatrace, open the Dashboards app.
  3. Click Import dashboard and upload the JSON file.
  4. Once imported, review and adjust:
getStartedHtml:
1. Import the dashboard JSON into the Dashboards app
  2. Ingest the sample log data or point it at your own
  3. Review and adjust the dashboard to your process
